_about: SCIRM error dictionary. Every code a person might see is translated once here: what it means, why it usually happens, how to fix it, who owns it, and how urgent it is. Keys are '<source>:<code>'. Site-specific translator codes are mapped in scirm/local_codes.json (not committed; see local_codes.example.json).

detector:envelope_invalid.meaning: The file's envelope is malformed, so it cannot be trusted or processed as sent
causes: File truncated or altered in transit
fix: Ask the partner to resend
Compare the control numbers and segment counts against the original
If edited by hand, find out who and why
detector:envelope_invalid.impact: The document is not processed until it is resent

detector:unknown_sender.meaning: The file came from a sender ID that is not a registered trading partner
causes: Partner changed its ID without notice
New partner not yet set up
fix: Do not process the file
Confirm with the real partner by phone, using a number already on file
Register the ID only after confirmation
detector:unknown_sender.impact: Possible fraud: an outsider posing as a partner

detector:replayed_control_number.meaning: This interchange control number was already received from this sender
causes: Partner resent without new control numbers
fix: Compare with the earlier file
If identical, discard as a duplicate
If different, treat as suspicious and confirm with the partner
detector:replayed_control_number.impact: Risk of duplicate orders or payments

detector:invoice_no_po.meaning: The invoice references a purchase order that does not exist
causes: Wrong PO number keyed by the supplier
fix: Hold payment
Ask the supplier for the correct PO
Escalate if no PO can be found

detector:invoice_without_shipment.meaning: The invoice bills an order with no ship notice received
fix: Hold payment
Request the 856 or a proof of delivery
Confirm receipt in the warehouse
detector:invoice_without_shipment.impact: Payment held until receipt is confirmed

detector:price_above_po.meaning: The invoice price is above the PO price by more than the tolerance, or bills an item not on the PO
causes: Price change not agreed on the PO
fix: Pay at PO price or hold
Ask the supplier for a corrected invoice
Update the PO only with buyer approval

detector:quantity_over_shipped.meaning: More units are billed than were shipped by the invoice date
causes: Invoice sent before the second partial shipment
fix: Pay only for shipped quantity
Request a corrected invoice

detector:duplicate_invoice.meaning: The same charges were billed again under a new or altered invoice number
fix: Do not pay the second invoice
Tell the supplier which invoice it duplicates

detector:remit_to_changed.meaning: The invoice asks to be paid at a remit-to address that differs from the registered one
causes: Supplier moved its lockbox without notice
fix: Pay only to the registered address
Verify the change by calling a contact already on file, never one on the invoice
Change master data only after verification
detector:remit_to_changed.impact: Payment could be sent to a criminal

detector:ship_to_not_approved.meaning: The ship notice sends goods to a location that is not approved
causes: New site not yet added to master data
fix: Contact the carrier and supplier to confirm the destination
Stop the shipment if not confirmed
detector:ship_to_not_approved.impact: Goods could be lost or stolen

detector:unusual_purchase_order.meaning: A purchase order was entered off-hours with an abnormal quantity
fix: Confirm with the buyer who entered it
Hold the order until confirmed
Review the account's sign-ins

prevalidation:shipto_xref_missing.meaning: The ship-to location on the order has no cross-reference to a distribution center
causes: New or changed location never added to the cross-reference
ID sent in a different format or qualifier than the table expects
fix: Search the cross-reference with and without leading zeros
Confirm the location with the partner
Add the mapping
Release the held document
prevalidation:shipto_xref_missing.impact: The order cannot release to the warehouse; edits to related sales orders also fail

prevalidation:shipto_id_format.meaning: The ship-to ID matches a known location only after removing padding
causes: Partner pads IDs with leading zeros
fix: Normalize IDs before lookup
Store one canonical form in the cross-reference
prevalidation:shipto_id_format.impact: None once normalized; a hold without normalization

prevalidation:delivery_date_inside_lead_.meaning: The requested delivery date is sooner than the item's lead time allows
causes: Customer system does not use the agreed lead time
fix: Set the date from lead time automatically
Correct the lead time in the source system
Log any manual date change with user and reason
prevalidation:delivery_date_inside_lead_.impact: Manual date edits; late or rushed shipments

lag:ack_997_missing.meaning: No functional acknowledgment (997) came back for a document
fix: Check the provider's delivery log
Resend if not delivered
Contact the partner if delivered but not acknowledged
lag:ack_997_missing.impact: Unknown whether the partner has the document

lag:ack_997_late.meaning: The 997 came back later than the agreed window
fix: Check the hop timestamps for where time was lost
Raise with the partner if repeated

lag:po_ack_855_late.meaning: The PO acknowledgment (855) arrived later than the agreed window
fix: Follow up with the supplier
Track the supplier's late rate on the scorecard

lag:po_ack_855_missing.meaning: No PO acknowledgment (855) was received for a purchase order
causes: Supplier not set up to send 855s
fix: Check for a held or rejected 855
Ask the supplier to send it

x12:AK5:E.meaning: Accepted, but the partner noted errors
fix: Read the AK3/AK4 detail
Fix the map in the next release; no resend needed

x12:AK5:R.meaning: The partner rejected the transaction set
causes: Syntax or code errors in what we sent
fix: Read the AK3/AK4 detail
Fix the map or data
Resend
x12:AK5:R.impact: The partner does not have the document

causes: Map writes a segment the partner does not support
fix: Remove or rename the segment in the map

causes: Segment not allowed at this point
fix: Check the partner's guide for where it belongs

causes: Map leaves out a required segment
fix: Add the segment to the map

x12:AK3:4.meaning: Loop occurs over its maximum times
causes: Too many repeats of a loop
fix: Split the document or cap the loop
Cap repeats in the map

x12:AK3:6.meaning: Segment not in the defined transaction set
fix: Check the version in GS08

causes: Map writes segments out of order
fix: Reorder the segments in the map

x12:AK3:8.meaning: Segment has data element errors (see AK4)
fix: Read the AK4 lines for the exact element

causes: Source field empty in the ERP
fix: Find the element position in the AK4
Populate it from the ERP field

causes: A paired element was sent without its partner
fix: Send both elements of the pair, or neither
Trim trailing elements in the map

causes: Value shorter than the minimum length
fix: Pad or correct the value

causes: Value longer than the maximum length
fix: Truncate or correct the value

causes: Delimiter or non-ASCII character in the data
fix: Clean the source text

causes: Code not in the agreed code list
fix: Align the code list with the partner's guide
Use CCYYMMDD and check the source date
Use HHMM and check the source time

causes: Two elements sent that must not appear together
fix: Send only one of the pair

iam:sod_conflict.meaning: One user holds two permissions that together allow fraud without anyone else noticing
causes: Roles added over time and never reviewed
Small team covering for each other
fix: Remove one of the two permissions, or split the role
If the team is too small to split, require a second approver and review the audit log weekly
iam:sod_conflict.impact: Fraud can be committed and hidden by one person

iam:dormant_privileged.meaning: A privileged account has not been used within the review window
fix: Disable the account or remove the privileged role
Confirm with the manager before re-enabling
iam:dormant_privileged.impact: An unused account with power is an easy target for takeover

iam:unauthorized_release.meaning: Someone without the required permission tried to release a held document or alert
causes: Attempt to push through a suspicious document
fix: Confirm with the user why they tried
If the hold was security-related, review the document before anyone releases it
iam:unauthorized_release.impact: A held, possibly fraudulent document could be processed

iam:audit_log_tampered.meaning: The audit log's hash chain is broken: an entry was edited, inserted or deleted
causes: Someone altered the log to hide an action
fix: Preserve the file as evidence
Restore from backup and compare
Treat releases and changes after the break as unverified
iam:audit_log_tampered.impact: Who did what can no longer be proven
